summary: Frontend-only redesign verification of /transactions (admin). All 15 requested flows verified end-to-end: header/breadcrumb, 5 KPI cards with real numbers, KPI-click filtering (pending/approved/rejected/total-clear/expense-toggle), active filter chips + Clear All, search filter, status & type dropdowns, Advanced Filters right drawer, sortable Date/Amount columns, sticky header, row-click Transaction Details Drawer (Overview/Attachments/History tabs + Approve/Reject/Edit/Delete actions), row Approve/Reject icons (approve confirmed working & row removed from pending), bulk selection toolbar visible on select-all, view modes Table/Compact/Grouped, pagination (rows-per-page 10/25/50/100, page-next, page-N, Showing X-Y of N text), New Transaction dropdown (Expense/Income/Investment) opening prefilled dialog, create+save producing a new row (TEST_REDESIGN_TXN visible with ₹123), Export/Import CSV buttons present. Existing backend endpoints untouched and functioning.

issues: Currency formatter inr() drops decimals — user typed 123.45, row shows ₹123 (cosmetic; existing behavior of inr() helper, not introduced by redesign)

critical_code_review_comments: Transactions.jsx is 861 lines — approaching the >700-line split threshold. Consider extracting KPI cards, DetailsDrawer, AdvancedFiltersDrawer, and NewEditDialog into separate components for maintainability.
rejectTxn uses window.prompt() which is a poor UX (blocking, unstyled). Consider a proper Dialog with a Reason textarea.
remove() uses window.confirm() — consider a proper AlertDialog for consistency with BulkDeleteDialog.
The `filtered` useMemo has eslint-disable on exhaustive-deps because nameOf reads `entities` — dependency is included but the comment is stale/misleading; can be removed.

Client-side pagination on a 1141-row payload works but the server returns everything each load — for larger tenants this will be slow. Consider server-side pagination in a follow-up (out of redesign scope).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test transaction 'TEST_REDESIGN_TXN' (expense, ₹123) — cleanup optional per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Transactions redesign fully verified from UI: KPIs, filters, chips, search, sort, view modes, drawer, row & drawer approve/reject, new-txn dropdown+create+save, pagination, rows-per-page, bulk toolbar. Data-testids all resolve correctly. No functional regressions observed against pre-existing backend endpoints (approve, bulk-approve, POST /transactions, etc).
